headline: Bitcoin ended the US week near $76,000 after an 11-week low, and the US Treasury moved to cut crypto exchange MEXC off from the American financial system.

market.asOf: From Investing.com at 5:30pm ET Fri 6 Nov (22:30 UTC); CoinGecko could not be reached this run and no SOL figure was found. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Fear: alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index read 28 on Fri 6 Nov, per Coin Gabbar. A newer reading could not be confirmed this run.

stories.title: Bitcoin ends the US week near $76,000 after an 11-week low
stories.summary: A much stronger than expected US jobs report raised the odds that the Fed raises interest rates in December, and bitcoin briefly fell below $75,000. It recovered to about $76,000 by the US evening but was still heading for a fifth losing week in a row.
points: Bitcoin was up 0.4% at $76,031.6 at 5:30pm ET Friday and set to lose 2% on the week, its fifth straight weekly loss, per Investing.com.
The intraday low was $74,762 per Bitcoin.com and $74,780.91 per Decrypt, the weakest since 21 August.
US payrolls rose 165,000 in October against a 65,000 forecast and unemployment fell to 4.1%, per Investing.com.
CME FedWatch odds of a quarter-point December hike rose to nearly 79% from almost 73% before the data, per Investing.com.
About $1.05B of leveraged bets were forcibly closed in 24 hours, $930M of them bets on rising prices, per Decrypt (CoinGlass data).

stories.title: US Treasury moves to cut crypto exchange MEXC off from the US financial system
stories.summary: The Treasury's anti-money-laundering unit, FinCEN, named offshore exchange MEXC a primary money laundering concern. Once the order takes effect, US banks and payment firms may not move money to or from MEXC, so anyone with funds there should watch for disruption.
points: Treasury alleges MEXC handled about $16B in transactions linked to Iran, North Korea and Russia, per The Block.
Decrypt says the activity ran between May 2021 and May 2026, with about $1.5B tied to Russian sanctions evasion.
The order takes effect 30 days after it is published in the Federal Register, per Bitcoin Magazine.
The Block reports MEXC said it keeps anti-money-laundering controls and will block users in Iran and North Korea; Bitcoin Magazine says MEXC had made no public statement as of Friday evening.

Bitcoin Magazine: FinCEN cuts off MEXC

stories.title: Binance hack: $3.1B still in hacker wallets as withdrawals reopen
stories.summary: Blockchain analysts at Elliptic say the hackers behind the Binance theft are slowly converting stolen coins into bitcoin, but only a negligible amount has likely been cashed out. Binance says it has replaced virtually all stolen assets and plans to reopen more withdrawals by the end of next week.
points: About $3.11B sits in addresses linked to the theft, $2.85B is frozen and $470M is unaccounted for, per The Block citing Elliptic.
About $124M of stolen tokens has been swapped into bitcoin, across more than 20,000 wallets on 16 blockchains, per The Block.
The Block puts the total breach at $6.43B; Bloomingbit reports $6.3B and says Binance has not said how much of its assets were in hot wallets.
Binance aims to reopen HYPE, INJ, APT, PLASMA, NEAR and LTC withdrawals by the end of next week, per The Block.

briefs.title: Bitcoin ETFs: Friday flows not out yet
briefs.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $430M on Thursday; BlackRock's IBIT had $105M of outflows, its fifth straight day, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Treasury drops $250 crypto Travel Rule plan
briefs.summary: FinCEN and the Fed withdrew a 2020 proposal to lower the threshold for collecting transfer data from $3,000 to $250, per The Block.

briefs.title: Crypto-in-401(k) rule moves to White House review
briefs.summary: The Labor Department sent a proposed rule on alternative assets, including crypto, in 401(k) plans to the White House for review, per The Block.

briefs.title: Strive posts $509M profit from bitcoin gains
briefs.summary: Strive bought 15,124 BTC in October and now holds 43,124 BTC; its Q3 profit came from paper gains on its bitcoin, per The Block.

briefs.title: TeraWulf's mining revenue falls 69% as AI leasing grows
briefs.summary: Q3 bitcoin mining revenue fell to $13.2M while data-center leasing revenue rose 774% to about $63M, per The Block.

briefs.title: Riot cuts its bitcoin holdings by 79%
briefs.summary: Riot's holdings fell to 2,418 BTC from 11,380, mainly to fund data center development, per BitcoinTreasuries.

briefs.title: $TRUMP memecoin hits a record low
briefs.summary: The coin fell over 22% this week to a record low of $1.116 on Thursday, about 99% below its $73.43 peak, per Investing.com.
